keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1800-1892: Unyanyembe. The page lists it among 'a number of Nyamwezi kingdoms' in the early 1800s and gives no area or boundary; the 70 km radius at Tabora is the researcher's reading. From 1858 the Arab traders 'helped him expel his rival Mkasiwa' and settled at Tabora.

region.text: Unyanyembe, the Nyamwezi kingdom around Tabora (a radius; the pages give no boundary)

ledger.note: 1893: the Germans pacify Unyamwezi. 'Unyamwezi was pacified by the Germans in 1893; only Chief Isike around Tabora giving any serious opposition'; 'Isike's death in 1893 cemented German's victory'. The German attempts of 1890 and 1891 had failed, and Nyanso had been installed as the Germans' allied ruler of Unyanyembe before Isike's defeat.

wars.outcome: German victory in 1893: the first attempt in 1890 failed, the Germans lost half their troops at Kalenga in 1891, two major attacks on Isike failed before 1893, and Isike's death in 1893 ended the resistance.

notes:
New state (Cliopatria has no Nyamwezi row). Pages: Nyamwezi people and Mirambo. The Nyamwezi chiefdoms were many; Unyanyembe (Tabora) is the one the page follows. Not on the pages: the founding of Unyanyembe, the Arab settlement at Kazeh/Tabora (Arabs 'reached the Nyamwezi by 1825'), the Ulyankhulu state, Ukimbu/Nyungu-ya-Mawe, Msiri's Yeke state (af-06), an earlier end of the war (the page runs it to 1884). The 1800 start is a placeholder at confidence 1.

Page dates: 1858 Mnywasele inherits Unyanyembe and the Arabs help him expel Mkasiwa; 1860 'greater conflict between Unyanyembe and Ulyankhulu' (Mkasiwa then gains the throne); 1891 Isike is the year before his defeat (the page also says his death in 1893). Disagreement inside the page: the first German attack on Isike failed in 1890, the Kalenga defeat was in 1891, 'prior to 1893... two major unsuccessful attacks'.

Counterparts needing dossiers: urambo (this batch), german-africa (af-08), Ulyankhulu (none), Nyungu-ya-Mawe's Ukimbu (none).
